Nothing on the central bank or payments.

facts.fact: Ecofin Agency reports that the Central African Republic plans to complete implementation of its universal service fund in 2026, financed by a 2% levy on operator revenue, to extend telecom access to uncovered and underserved areas, as an ARCEP priority presented on 15 April 2026.

systems.system: universal service fund (Law No. 18.002 of 17 January 2018)

CAF.note: The fund framework only supports ICT training in general terms; no programme or measured share is stated.
Only adapted offers and social pricing for persons with disabilities under the fund; no accessibility of information or digital services is stated.
The 2% levy is in a 2018 law and 2019 decree with the fund not yet collecting; no budget amount or collecting fund is stated.
Nothing on government payments to people.
The only usage figure (about 12%) is DataReportal's, which the study notes and never uses.
Nothing on mobile money or retail payments.
